corrections.title: Resident Evil
corrections.current: First released in Germany on March 12, 2002
corrections.correct: German release was March 21, 2002 (Wikipedia body text says March 12 but its own infobox says March 21; IMDb and German FFA 2002 hit list both give 21.03.2002). Year 2002 unaffected.

corrections.title: Ju-On: The Grudge
corrections.current: Premiered at Screamfest October 18, 2002; Japan release August 23, 2003
corrections.correct: Japan theatrical release was January 25, 2003 (August 23, 2003 is the date of Ju-On: The Grudge 2). The record copies an apparently erroneous Wikipedia infobox date. Year 2002 (Screamfest premiere) unaffected.
